name: n8n_generate_workflow
description: Generate an n8n workflow from a natural language description using AI. Call with just a description to get workflow proposals. Then call again with deploy_id to deploy a chosen proposal, or set skip_cache=true to generate a fresh workflow. Use confirm_deploy=true to deploy a previously generated workflow.

description.description: Clear description of what the workflow should do. Include: trigger type (webhook, schedule, manual), services to integrate (Slack, Gmail, etc.), and the logic/flow.

skip_cache.description: Set to true to skip proposals and generate a fresh workflow from scratch. Returns a preview — call again with confirm_deploy=true to deploy it.

deploy_id.description: ID of a proposal to deploy. Get proposal IDs from a previous call that returned status "proposals".

confirm_deploy.description: Set to true to deploy the workflow from the last generation preview.
